name: redox-films
description: REDOXDESIGNX motion film (the range, then how to order), built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render Redox-Vertical out/redoxdesignx-how-to-order-9x16.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --x264-preset=slow --color-space=bt709 --pixel-format=yuv420p && python scripts/master.py out/redoxdesignx-how-to-order-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:wide: remotion render Redox-Wide out/redoxdesignx-how-to-order-16x9.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --x264-preset=slow --color-space=bt709 --pixel-format=yuv420p && python scripts/master.py out/redoxdesignx-how-to-order-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:wide && npm run captions
